_note: The Sepolia deployment of the channel contract, as a record a reader can re-derive.
This file exists so that a public document — the root README — can cite a file instead of
restating a hex string. Every value below was read from a node with the query beside it, not
copied from a document; the deployment's own working files (~/.hydra/sepolia-env.sh,
~/.hydra-msg/state.json) are gitignored, so without this record the tree cannot show that the
contract exists and 'absent from tracked source' reads as 'not deployed'.
Re-derive it: run the two queries in `verified_by` against `rpc` and compare.
This is NOT strk20.json. That file wants three MAINNET hashes each proving a real call
against the STRK20 pool; this is Sepolia and it deploys our own contract, so it belongs here
and would be a false claim there.

deployed_by._type_note: INVOKE because the deploy went through an account. It is the transaction that deployed the contract; calling it 'the deploy transaction' is loose.
